calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_year_start_date, MIN(calendar_date) as earliest_date, MAX(calendar_date) as latest_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_year_start_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
  d.region,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON f.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store d ON f.store_key = d.store_key
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND d.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT DISTINCT dd.fiscal_year, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON f.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, f.channel_code
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_year, f.channel_code

calls.statement:
SELECT MIN(business_date) as min_date, MAX(business_date) as max_date, COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales

SELECT 
  d.region,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales,
  SUM(r.units_sold) as units_sold,
  SUM(r.receipts) as receipts,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(r.net_sales) DESC) as rank
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_store d ON r.store_id = d.store_id
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON r.business_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.is_current = TRUE
  AND d.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT 
  d.region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.store_id) as num_stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN r.business_date END) as days_with_sales
FROM dim_store d
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON d.store_id = r.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON r.business_date = dd.calendar_date AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
WHERE d.is_current = TRUE
  AND d.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY d.region

calls.statement:
-- Final ranking of store regions by net sales for FY2026/27
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(r.net_sales) DESC) as rank,
  d.region,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_store d ON r.store_id = d.store_id
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON r.business_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.is_current = TRUE
  AND d.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY rank
